anamnesis.body: {{professional}} is putting your plan together and needs to know a few things about your health and routine: what you take, what you do not eat, how you sleep. It takes a few minutes, and you can do it from your phone. The link is valid for {{days}} days.
anamnesis.footer: Only someone with this link can open the form, and your answers go straight to {{professional}}. If you were not expecting this e-mail, ignore it.
anamnesis.subject: {{professional}} asked you to answer a few questions
anamnesis.text:
{{name}}, {{professional}} needs a few details about your health and routine to put your plan together.

Open this address to answer (valid for {{days}} days):
{{url}}

If you were not expecting this e-mail, ignore it.
anamnesis.title: {{name}}, a few details are missing

booking.footer: The slot is already on your calendar — nothing to confirm. If you cannot make it, reschedule or cancel from there.
booking.subject: {{person}} booked {{service}} — {{when}}
booking.text: {{name}}, {{person}} booked {{service}} for {{when}}. Contact: {{contact}}. Open the calendar: {{url}}
booking.title: {{name}}, a slot was booked on your calendar

deletion.body:
Someone requested, from inside your account, to delete it. Nothing has been deleted. We will get in touch to understand what happened and agree on the next steps — if you really want to leave, we will handle it with you.

If this was not you, cancel the request at the address below and change your password.
deletion.footer: In the meantime your account keeps working normally, with all of your data in place.
deletion.subject: We received your account deletion request
deletion.text:
{{name}}, we received a request to delete your VAFIT account.

Nothing has been deleted. We will get in touch to understand what happened and agree on the next steps.

If this was not you, cancel the request here and change your password:
{{url}}

In the meantime your account keeps working normally.
deletion.title: {{name}}, we received your deletion request

invite.body:
{{trainerName}} granted you access to VAFIT. There you follow your workouts and your record.

Sign in with the e-mail {{email}} and the password {{trainerName}} agreed with you.
invite.footer: Do not know your password? Use "I forgot my password" on the sign-in screen, or talk to your professional.
invite.subject: Your VAFIT access is ready
invite.text:
{{name}}, {{trainerName}} granted you access to VAFIT.

Sign in at {{url}} with the e-mail {{email}} and the password agreed with {{trainerName}}.

Do not know the password? Use "I forgot my password" on the sign-in screen.
invite.title: {{name}}, your access is open

request.body:
{{professionalName}} ({{professionalEmail}}) wants to follow you on VAFIT.

If you grant it, this person will see your history and build plans together with the other professionals who already care for you. You can revoke this access whenever you want.

The link is valid for {{days}} days.
request.footer: Do not know who is asking? Just ignore this e-mail — without your confirmation nobody sees anything.

reset.body: You asked to reset the password of your VAFIT account. Click the button below to choose a new one. The link is valid for {{minutes}} minutes and can be used only once.
reset.footer: If it was not you who asked, ignore this e-mail — your password stays the same and nobody accessed your account.
reset.subject: Reset your VAFIT password
reset.text:
{{name}}, you asked to reset your VAFIT password.

Open this address to choose a new password (valid for {{minutes}} minutes, single use):
{{url}}

If it was not you who asked, ignore this e-mail — your password stays the same.
